name: AI or Not? AI Generated Images Detector
caption: Implementing a training pipeline to discern AI-generated images, using the 'aiornot' dataset for image classification. Fine-tunes a Vision Transformer (ViT), a model introduced by researchers at Google Brain.

name: Federated Learning Notes
caption: Federated learning is a decentralized machine learning approach where model training occurs across multiple edge devices or servers holding local data, preserving data privacy. Notes covering recent variants of the approach.
